items.t: Transmission lights flash and car goes into limp mode
items.job: Replace transmission park/neutral position switch and adjust
items.note: A dealer quoted $300-400 on the Volvo owners club page; CarComplaints owners report about $600.

items.t: Shudder when the torque converter locks up
items.note: The Volvo owners club page cites about $250 for the solenoid.

items.t: Loss of oil pressure from broken oil pump part
items.note: RepairPal estimates $1,217-1,523 for an S90 oil pump replacement.

items.t: Hard starting from sticking exhaust valves
items.job: Diagnose hard starting (codes and compression test)
items.note: Based on RepairPal check engine diagnosis pricing; a valve job costs far more.

items.t: Idle surge or no-start from coolant temperature sensor
items.job: Check engine diagnosis and coolant temperature sensor test
items.note: The sensor itself is an inexpensive part.

items.t: Brake pedal pulsation from warped front rotors
items.note: RepairPal lists $185-242 for 1998 S90 pads; new rotors add to the cost.

items.t: A/C leaks or stops blowing cold
items.job: Repair A/C leak and recharge (compressor if failed)
items.note: RepairPal lists an A/C recharge at about $320-420 and a compressor at about $1,800-2,400.

items.t: 12V battery drains or critical charge warning
items.job: Test and replace 12V battery, update software
items.note: RepairPal lists $344-372 for 2018 and newer, $442-470 for 2017.

items.t: Center screen freezes, restarts or loses GPS
items.note: Priced as diagnostic time (RepairPal lists diagnosis at about $150-290); often free under warranty.

items.t: Parking brake service message or brake will not release
items.note: Priced as diagnostic time (RepairPal lists diagnosis at about $150-290); often free under warranty.

items.t: Brake vibration or shudder when stopping
items.note: RepairPal lists $293-350 for 2017-2024 pads; rotors add to the cost.

items.t: Harsh shift when putting it in gear
items.note: Priced as diagnostic time (RepairPal lists diagnosis at about $150-290); often free under warranty.

items.t: Transmission jumps back into Park after starting
items.note: Priced as diagnostic time (RepairPal lists diagnosis at about $150-290); often free under warranty.

items.t: Mild-hybrid starter-generator charging fault
items.note: Priced as diagnostic time; a replaced generator module costs more but is usually under warranty.

items.t: Check engine light with misfire code
items.note: Priced as diagnostic time (RepairPal lists diagnosis at about $150-290); often free under warranty.

items.t: Creaking steering wheel or dead audio buttons
items.job: Diagnose steering wheel noise or switch fault
items.note: Priced as diagnostic time; a new switch panel adds parts cost.

items.t: Weak heat or uneven climate airflow
items.note: Priced as diagnostic time (RepairPal lists diagnosis at about $150-290); often free under warranty.

items.t: A/C drain can leak water into the cabin (recall)
Front passenger seat belt buckle can come loose (recall)
Curtain air bag bolts can break (recall)
Crash location may not reach emergency services (recall)
Front seat may be missing mounting nuts (recall)
Automatic emergency braking may not work (recall)
Fuel pump fuse can blow and stall the engine (recall)
High-voltage battery can short and catch fire (recall)
Airbag control unit may not be secured (recall)
Seat belt may not hold a child seat (recall)
ABS and stability control can shut off (recall)
Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
Transmission overheats and wears out early
items.note: Based on KBB dealer pricing for a 1998 S90: $9,107-$9,719 ($6,848-$7,272 parts, $2,259-$2,447 labor; hours worked out from that labor figure). A used or rebuilt unit from an independent shop usually costs much less. A fluid change caught early costs far less than a replacement.

items.t: Timing belt or tensioner failure
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and idler pulley
items.note: Based on YourMechanic: S90 average $852 ($516 parts, $336 labor), and $1,397-$1,404 for the 1997-1998 2.9L (shop/dealer $1,660-$2,452). KBB 1998 V90: $409-$919. If the belt already broke, valve damage costs far more.
